    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ApiAccessDeniedHandler
    Writes the JSON 403 Forbidden response for denied authenticated API requests.
    ApiAuthenticationEntryPoint
    Writes the JSON 401 Unauthorized response for unauthenticated API requests.

    Stable error codes used by ApiErrorResponse and client-side error handling.

    Standard JSON representation of an API error.
    ApiException
    Runtime exception carrying the HTTP status and stable error code for an API failure.

    Registers authentication-specific Spring beans.

    Exposes registration, login and logout endpoints backed by an HttpOnly JWT cookie.

    Builds the secure, HttpOnly cookie used to transport the MDD authentication JWT.

    CommentCreatedEvent

    CommentResponse
    Comment data displayed with its author and creation timestamp.

    Validated payload used to add a non-empty comment to a post.

    Validated payload used to create a post in a topic.

    Exposes the authenticated user's profile and profile-update operations.
    CurrentUserResponse
    Public profile fields returned for the authenticated user.

    Retrieves and updates the profile attached to the authenticated account.

    Converts application, validation and unexpected exceptions into client-safe JSON errors.

    Restores the security context from a valid, non-invalidated JWT cookie.

    Authenticated account identifier and session version extracted from a valid JWT.

    Verifies credentials and creates a JWT for a valid existing account.
